metadata.obs_schema: 21-dim one-hot: op[0:3] (SET=0, SWAP=1, ADD=2), reg_a[3:7], reg_b[7:11], immediate[11:21]; V readers receive x_t (21) + 1 validity bit = 22 features
metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. V readers are analysis-only, fit on ordinary TRAIN ADD, tuned on VAL, evaluated once on the untouched canonical TEST. Every predeclared family/history/target is reported; no test-based selection. Bayes ceilings are U's, unmodified.

primary_decision.rule_note: V-A if some reader test>=0.50 AND held-out>=0.30 at L4/full; V-B if best reader test<=0.25 AND held-out<=0.25 AND Bayes-reader>=0.30; V-C if the best reader improves over the U MLP-128 baseline by >=0.15 without V-A; V-MIX on material E/F disagreement or a genuine GRU-vs-TCN disagreement.
